workarounds.symptom: Tool parameter validation silently skips $ref / anyOf / oneOf schemas and crashes on tuple-form items
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(tools): validate arguments with jsonschema without coercion. Target files: nanobot/agent/tools/base.py, nanobot/agent/tools/cron.py, nanobot/agent/tools/exec_session.py. . This is an alternative implementation to #6486, building on the bug report and reproductions from @xiong-wei1. (Ref: https://github.com/HKUDS/nanobot/pull/6648)
